title: Proprietes galoisiennes des points d'ordre fini des courbes elliptiques
format_note: Scanned author-hosted paper with one added bibliographic cover page; theorem pages were rendered and read visually.

used_locators.scope: Equivalent adelic openness and full-factor assertions, and mod-ell surjectivity outside finite exceptions.
For a non-CM elliptic curve over a number field, mod-ell image is full outside finitely many ell.
Adelic torsion image is open and contains the entire ell-adic factor outside finitely many ell.

role: Precisely scoped primary open-image input; no numerical exceptional-prime bound or proof of the imported theorem is claimed.
